```yaml
name: Playwright Docs Check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  playwright-docs-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v2
      with:
        node-version: '14'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci

    - name: Run Playwright tests
      run: npx playwright test --headed --project=docs
```
